name: blocklist-mirror
description: This bouncer exposes CrowdSec's active decisions via provided HTTP endpoints in pre-defined formats. It can be used by network appliances which support consumption of blocklists via HTTP. mkdir /mnt/user/appdata/blocklist-mirror cd /mnt/user/appdata/blocklist-mirror nano cfg.yaml Copy in the contents of the cfg.yaml located from https://docs.crowdsec.net/docs/bouncers/blocklist-mirror Save, close and run the container
